verdict.rationale: Databricks clearly ships versioned REST APIs: the reference hub lists versions side by side (e.g. Jobs v2.0) and recommends the latest. It also documents deprecations with migration guides, such as the legacy SQL API moving from /preview/sql/queries to api/2.0/sql/queries, and the CLI migration from 0.18 to 0.205+. However, the evidence shows only case-by-case deprecation notices with vague timing ("support will end soon"), not a formal, documented deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a published platform-wide deprecation policy with notice periods or sunset timelines, stability/compatibility guarantees per API version, and independent corroboration.
